title: Avenger Cruise 220 Chrome
description: The Bajaj Auto Avenger Cruise 220 Chrome is combines low-slung road presence with generous low-end torque rumble, positioned in the Performance Cruiser segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 110 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
